body:
ENDED 2026-11-13 ~09:00Z. Both coordinators sent "rollback hold ended" (Engram::Fable #7794, Fable2 #7795). Evidence:
(1) the installed binaries: Central b2fc71a9, re-read by Fable2; DL560 5b5ac67e, from runner step 1;
(2) about 12 h of normal writes on both sides, including independent evaluations, with no store errors;
(3) readiness 6/6, re-run on Central at ~09:00Z;
(4) no lost or garbled data reported.
DL560 live-store readiness (step 2) was withdrawn as unnecessary, and Fable2's Exception #16 was withdrawn before use.
Engram installs may resume (Merger, w-180d first). K3 S2b's landing is released under #7784, with its floor raise live only at the coordinated all-host restart.
Pending: Greg's decision on the ~/.engram/backups AACB snapshots (asked through Asistant #1531). Fable2's .tmp/fable2-dl560-pkg was removed after a path check.

Correction (09:02Z): Exception #16 WAS used before my withdrawal reached s4. s4 ran both readiness invocations once each at 08:59:56-57Z, under the exception while it was in force (relay #185, with disclosure #186).
Verbatim facts: both DL560 stores, questly and PhoenixCodeNav, returned ready=true and mutation_enabled=false, with build.source_revision aacb13707bc9…, build_fingerprint ddd136df…e388 and executable_sha256 5b5ac67e…3e68, exit 0 and empty stderr. The only side effect was the -shm touch.
This corroborates condition (1). s4 is told to remove its .evidence/s4-aacb-hold-readiness after a path check.
